clips.caption: Jev is on. / opens the query line: type to filter, ~question asks Jev.
Plain text filters live as you type.
A leading ~ switches the badge to ✦ Jev. Nothing is sent yet.
Enter asks Jev once. Rows wait with a clock icon.
Scores arrive. Weak rows dim; relevance bars sit on the right.
v hides weak rows. The status bar counts what is hidden.
m turns the same words into a literal text filter.
Tab after tag: offers the most frequent tag as grey ghost text.
Typing narrows it. Other matches line up beside it.
